gaps.sentence: The old factory will be ___ into flats (MODERN).
gaps.hint: verb needed in the passive (-ise); past participle
gaps.explanation: The suffix -ise forms the verb: modernise. The passive 'will be' needs the past participle 'modernised'.

gaps.sentence: Don't ___ your children — let them make their own mistakes (PROTECT).
gaps.hint: protect too much (over-); a base verb is needed
gaps.explanation: The prefix over- means excessively: overprotect means to protect too much. A base verb follows 'Don't'.

gaps.hint: verb needed with a singular subject (-ate)
gaps.explanation: The suffix -ate forms the verb: activate. The singular subject 'alarm' needs the -s form 'activates'.

gaps.sentence: The company is a major ___ (EMPLOY) in the region.
gaps.hint: the company gives jobs — it is the one who employs
gaps.explanation: An employer gives work; an employee receives it. The sentence is about the company.

gaps.sentence: Be careful not to ___ the medicine — read the label twice (USE).
gaps.explanation: The prefix mis- means wrongly: misuse means to use something incorrectly. A base verb follows 'not to'.
After 'complete' a noun is needed: darkness (-ness noun of 'dark').

gaps.sentence: The ___ between rich and poor is widening (DIVIDE).
gaps.explanation: The subject must be a noun: division (-sion). 'Divisive' is an adjective.

gaps.sentence: In my opinion, that restaurant is ___ — the food is nothing special (RATE).
gaps.explanation: 'Nothing special' shows the restaurant is praised too much: overrated (over- + rated).
